MICHAEL JACKSON LIVE EARTH SONG GERMANY 🇩🇪 1999 (4K REMASTERED)
snippet.description:
Remastered by me for you - enjoy ☺️ ❤️🙏🏻

During a 1999 concert in Munich, Germany, Michael Jackson fell over 27 feet when the bridge he was standing on during a performance of "Earth Song" collapsed. Despite the fall, he finished the concert before being taken to the hospital, where he was treated for severe bruising, a sprained ankle, and a strained back. The incident caused him chronic back pain, but he was otherwise unharmed, and no one else was injured. 

Details of the accident :

Location: Olympic Stadium, Munich, Germany

Date: June 27, 1999

Cause: The bridge, which was a prop for the "Earth Song" performance, collapsed due to a technical malfunction.

Height: Jackson fell approximately 27 feet.

Aftermath:
He immediately got up, returned to the stage, and finished performing "Earth Song" and "You Are Not Alone".

He collapsed backstage after the show and was taken to the hospital.

He was diagnosed with a strained back, a sprained ankle, and severe bruising.
The accident is said to have permanently damaged his spine.
